text.BHSA NEH 13:12: וְכָל־יְהוּדָ֗ה הֵבִ֜יאוּ מַעְשַׂ֧ר הַדָּגָ֛ן וְהַתִּירֹ֥ושׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֖ר לָאֹוצָרֹֽות׃
text.KJV NEH 13:12: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
text.BHSA NEH 13:13: וָאֹוצְרָ֣ה עַל־אֹ֠וצָרֹות שֶׁלֶמְיָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְצָדֹ֣וק הַסֹּופֵ֗ר וּפְדָיָה֙ מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְעַל־יָדָ֔ם חָנָ֥ן בֶּן־זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָ֑ה כִּ֤י נֶאֱמָנִים֙ נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לַחֲלֹ֥ק לַאֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ פ
text.KJV NEH 13:13: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
text.BHSA NEH 13:14: זָכְרָה־לִּ֥י אֱלֹהַ֖י עַל־זֹ֑את וְאַל־תֶּ֣מַח חֲסָדַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהַ֖י וּבְמִשְׁמָרָֽיו׃
text.KJV NEH 13:14: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
